objective: Build a version-pinned, coverage-measured, searchable and executable white-box account of JAX-to-TPU, including transformations, compiler passes, libtpu compiler/runtime, LLO and hardware mapping.

current_phase.title: Runtime provenance and source-built jaxlib
notes: P0 core is closed with machine-checked baseline, evidence, coverage, architecture and recovery-state contracts; L4/L5 claims remain fail-closed until their contracts and required TPU inputs exist.
Tokamax and the private framework remain external inputs for early workload intake and feature census.
An unwrapped exploratory CPU build was launched only to populate the Bazel cache; its live state and result are deliberately excluded from durable evidence.

milestones.title: Version-pinned plan, evidence and coverage contracts, public-boundary architecture, glossary and recovery state
notes: Pinned-source cross-review covers the public JAX, StableHLO/Shardy, XLA and PJRT/libtpu ABI seams; it does not claim libtpu, LLO or hardware internals are covered.
Semantic validators reject forged or spliced source, binary, capture, replay, coverage and recovery-state relationships through isolated negative fixtures.
VERSION-SKEW is a provenance qualifier, not an evidence level; the current CPU jaxlib remains intentionally version-skewed.

milestones.title: Engineering background and motivation grounded in public cases with a restricted supporting archive
notes: The documentation milestone adds fourteen public historical cases and clarifies the audience, cross-stack debugging, intervention points, upstream collaboration and validation needs.

Restricted source material remains outside Git behind an opaque archive locator and manifest hash. Historical issue and PR reports do not establish baseline execution evidence or increase coverage depth.

The P1 recovery queue is unchanged. Initial recovery checks encountered unavailable pinned source revisions; final project-status and evidence validation plus their selftests passed once the pinned source trees were available. No runtime experiment was performed for this milestone.

active_work.title: Close the current jaxlib wheel and dynamic-linker provenance capture
notes: Wheel filename/hash/size, embedded build revision, mapped native-library paths/hashes and VERSION-SKEW are recorded and validated.
A durable dynamic dependency and loader-resolution capture is still required before Q005 is complete.

active_work.title: Build and validate a jaxlib wheel from the pinned JAX/XLA sources
notes: The official wrapper-managed attempt is blocked on q005-native-dependency-capture.
The wrapper records fixed sources, tools, configuration, attempts, logs and wheel bytes and rejects unverified success states.

Before the official attempt, P1 must archive and hash the Bazel module graph, resolved repositories, registry/module-extension inputs and download integrity; the current --lockfile_mode=off contract is not a complete external-source closure.
runtime_validation remains fail-closed at not-run until P1 adds a non-cyclic hashed runtime-evidence contract.
The exploratory unwrapped build was cache warming only; the first official attempt starts after a committed Bazel dependency-closure checkpoint and writes durable artifacts.
